findings.title: Committed seller password in staging seed script
findings.evidence: Tracked source assigns SELLER_PASSWORD and uses it in signInWithPassword.
findings.impact: Any repository reader can authenticate as the seeded seller until credentials are rotated.
findings.remediation: Revoke/rotate the account immediately, purge the secret from Git history, and use CI secrets or ephemeral identities.
findings.test: secret scanning plus a credential-free seed test

findings.title: Reaper dry-run logs service-role key prefix
findings.impact: Partial secret material is exposed in local and GitHub Actions logs.
findings.remediation: Log only a boolean configured state; review/expire accessible logs and rotate if exposure occurred.
findings.test: assert runner output never contains any key substring

findings.title: Production deploy job installs from an invalid nested path
findings.evidence: Job-level working-directory is buyer-web and command is npm --prefix buyer-web ci.
findings.impact: The deployment job is expected to look for buyer-web/buyer-web/package.json and fail.
findings.remediation: Run npm ci in the existing working directory; exercise preview deployment.

findings.title: Production dispatch is not branch- or environment-protected in workflow
findings.evidence: workflow_dispatch with target_env=production bypasses a ref check; no GitHub environment is declared.
findings.impact: A workflow-capable actor may deploy a non-main revision to production.
findings.remediation: Require protected production environment and main ref; restrict manual dispatch.

findings.title: No database migration deployment gate
findings.evidence: All workflows were inspected; none invokes supabase db push, migration validation, or a schema compatibility test against staging.
findings.impact: Clients can deploy against an incompatible database or migrations can remain unapplied.
findings.remediation: Add protected staging migration/apply/verify promotion with backup and rollback runbook.
findings.test: fresh migration and staged upgrade pipeline

findings.title: Seller onboarding fee evidence is not an auditable approval workflow
findings.evidence: UTR is sent as auth metadata; no repository admin UI or durable onboarding-payment review model exists, while approval RPC is service_role-only.
findings.impact: Real seller approval and fee verification depend on undocumented manual database operations.
findings.remediation: Define and implement an approved administrative workflow and ledger, with least-privilege access and audit trail.

findings.title: Release health verification is non-blocking
findings.evidence: Non-2xx/3xx result prints Warning and exits successfully.
findings.impact: A broken deployment may be reported successful.
findings.remediation: Fail the job on unhealthy result and add authenticated smoke checks for critical paths.

findings.title: Keepalive hides Supabase failures
findings.evidence: Missing URL, request errors, and invalid URL all exit 0.
findings.impact: No alerting signal for a paused/unreachable backend.
findings.remediation: Fail operational checks and route alerts; retain a separate explicit local no-op mode.

findings.title: Full automated test execution is not reproducible locally
findings.evidence: Vitest and Flutter analysis did not complete locally; runtime test infrastructure unavailable.
findings.impact: Existing passing test claims cannot be independently reproduced from this workspace.
findings.remediation: Diagnose worker/process issue and document a one-command hermetic test setup.

findings.title: No production telemetry/error-monitoring integration found
findings.evidence: No Sentry, OpenTelemetry, Crashlytics, or equivalent dependency/configuration found; buyer error boundary logs only to console.
findings.impact: Payment/inventory incidents cannot be reliably correlated to buyer, seller, order, release, or RPC.
findings.remediation: Add privacy-reviewed error, release, job, and database-operation telemetry with alerts.
